note: Mostly seasonal campground northwest of Hill Spring near the Waterton Reservoir, with 40 x 100 and 50 x 100 ft sites with the Rocky Mountains as a backdrop, a fishing and swimming pond, indoor pickleball and playgrounds; no tenting. Short-term stays are sold only when a site is free: seasonal bookings take precedence and a short-term site may be changed. Units may be stored on site over winter. --Claude
